title: CommittedStrike
description: A StrikeCandidate accepted by the per-hand commit policy; a sound is now inevitable unless shadow is true (Phase 01 contract; produced by commit, Phase 05). docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.8.

frame_id.description: Frame at which the commit decision was taken.

derivation.description: Copied from the committed StrikeCandidate so results can be filtered/labelled without a join. DIRECT_HEAD never occurs in the live application.

arm.description: Which arm produced the candidate (README section 9). Written into every CommittedStrike (Phase 13, Task 13.3). Must agree with source: REACTIVE <-> A, RULE <-> B, MODEL <-> C-* (enforced below).

shadow.description: True when the commit was produced by a shadow arm (logged only, never scheduled to audio; Phase 05 architecture). t_commit then means 'the instant this arm would have committed'. Metrics treat shadow commits exactly like sounding ones.

t_commit.description: Instant the commit policy accepted the candidate (README section 5.2).

t_impact_target.description: Time the sound is intended to sound: t_impact_pred for anticipatory sources, t_commit ('now') for REACTIVE.

gain.description: Linear gain derived from intensity_proxy by the configured monotone mapping (Phase 04, Task 04.10).

refractory_until.description: No further commit for (hand_id, zone_id) before this instant. Persists across tracking resets (reset matrix).

episode_id.description: Geometry entry episode (README section 14); at most one commit per episode.
